text:
maria: FYI promo paused for canary. Staging job #6621 failed while unpacking artifacts on runner bk-9-2: zstd decompression error + symlink creation denied. Holding the promote until we confirm.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary promotion paused due to failed smoke job 6621 (artifact extraction error).

kai: Can someone paste the extractor logs?

maria: ```
[2026-03-21T15:10:11Z] extractor: decompress layer 4: zstd: (0x84) stream error
tar: ./web/node_modules/.bin/esbuild: Cannot create symlink: Permission denied
exit status 1
```

nina: Permission denied for symlink creation suggests the workspace volume is mounted with nodev or nosymfollow? We haven't changed mount flags recently though.

tarun: We did roll the extract helper package (artifact-extractor v1.2.0 -> v1.3.0) in the agent image last night. That changed extraction to use unprivileged chown for ownership mapping. Could be related.

dev-agent-bot: dev-agent-bot: Noted: agent pool bk-9 upgraded to agent v3.5.2 at 1765400000. No kernel/mount changes recorded.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Kernel log shows APPARMOR denial on bk-9-2 at 1765439980 referencing /var/buildkite/work/workspace. No recent changes to apparmor profiles from infra side.

kai: If apparmor blocked symlink creation and extractor fell back to streaming which uses more memory, that might explain zstd OOM/decompress failures. Does the job archive have large nested node_modules?

maria: Yes, payload is ~1.1GB after compression with lots of symlinks in node_modules/.bin.

nina: Short-term mitigation: pin canary to last good image (build 1765405000 sha:beefcafe) and re-run 6621 on a legacy runner without the new agent/extractor. If that passes, we can manually promote and open a follow-up to fix agent + apparmor interaction.

tarun: Agreed. I'll queue a rerun with BUILD_POOL=legacy and OVERRIDE_EXTRACTOR=1.2.0. If it fails there too, we'll consider artifact repackage.

maria: For release process: proposing we pin canary to sha:beefcafe and note in release notes: "Canary pinned due to CI artifact extract failures; infra investigating agent+apparmor interaction." Any objections?

kai: :thumbsup: from me. Also add SRE and Support to the release note blurb.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Manual pin applied: image sha256:beefcafe pinned for canary. Promo stays paused.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Created INFRA-9300: "apparmor denial causing artifact extract symlink failures on bk-9 pool" assigned to @tarun. https://tracker.redwood.ai/INFRA-9300

tarun: Taking INFRA-9300. I'll gather apparmor profiles, extractor logs, and agent env. Setting priority=P1 for release window.

nina: Proposed rollback decision flow: if legacy rerun produces 2 consecutive green smoke jobs, schedule manual promote outside auto-promo window and notify affected stakeholders. If rerun fails, escalate to packaging team to strip symlinks and produce a reupload.

maria: Sounds good. I'll add the note to the release notes and ping #product + #support.

tarun: Rerun queued on legacy pool now. ETA ~12m. Will post results.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Waiting on manual unblock. Use `/deploybot promote --pin-reason "ci-artifact-extract-failure"` after infra confirms root cause and reruns are green.

maria: Thanks all. Will hold promo until we get the two green smoke runs and infra signoff.
